## v0.1.0: first tagged release

gridappsd-go is a Go client library for GridAPPS-D / GOSS. It mirrors the
gridappsd-python client API: connection and two-step token authentication,
STOMP transport, publish/subscribe messaging, and request/reply helpers. The
gridappsd-ieee-2030_5-go bridge is the first consumer, using it for the
GridAPPS-D message-bus side of the STOMP-to-IEEE-2030.5 bridge.

### What changed

This is the first tagged release: everything below is "added" relative to
having no release at all.

- feat: `gridappsd.Connect` performs TLS dialing (fail-closed by default,
  plain-TCP opt-in via `AllowPlaintext`) and two-step token authentication,
  returning a durable `transport.Conn`.
- feat: `fieldbus` package: publish/subscribe message bus abstraction over
  the durable transport.
- feat: `internal/router`: subscription registry and per-destination read
  loop that dispatches frames to registered handlers.
- feat: `internal/reqresp`: request/reply pattern over STOMP, matching
  correlated responses to pending requests.
- feat: `topics` and `message` packages: GridAPPS-D topic naming helpers and
  the wire message envelope.
- feat: module path corrected to `github.com/GRIDAPPSD/gridappsd-go`,
  matching where the module is published and fetched from. All internal
  imports updated to match.

### For the bridge (gridappsd-ieee-2030_5-go)

The bridge already depends on this exact commit as a pseudo-version
(`v0.0.0-20260717032458-1823402cfecc`). This release does not change that
code: it tags the same commit as `v0.1.0` so the dependency is a stable
semver reference instead of a pseudo-version, and so future changes here are
version-discoverable (Dependabot, `go list -m -u`, changelog diffing)
instead of requiring a manual pseudo-version bump each time. Moving the
bridge's `go.mod` to `v0.1.0` is a follow-up in that repo, not part of this
release.

### Known issues (not fixed in this release)

These were found diagnosing a zero-bus-frames failure in the bridge's
end-to-end path. They describe this release's current behavior; a consumer
pinning v0.1.0 should know about them going in. None is fixed here: fixing
them is why this repo needs versioned releases going forward, not release
content itself.

- `transport.ConnConfig.HeartBeat` is symmetric: a consumer cannot request
  "I send heartbeats, I do not require receives" independently in each
  direction. Combined with an upstream `go-stomp` issue, a consumer cannot
  disarm the 15-second read deadline, only survive it.
- Subscription errors in `internal/router`'s read loop are dropped into an
  unread `errSink` channel (`internal/router/router.go`, `readLoop`/
  `errSink`), and the dead destination is left registered. A later
  `Subscribe` call can silently attach to a reader that already exited.
- A third defect is in `go-stomp` itself and is third-party; not tracked in
  this repo.

### Migration notes

- Database: no migration, this is a library with no persistence.
- Breaking changes: none within this repo (first release). Consumers
  already on the pre-release pseudo-version pin see no code change, only a
  new tag to move to.

### Deployment

- Module: `github.com/GRIDAPPSD/gridappsd-go@v0.1.0`
- No container image: this is a Go library, not a deployable service.
